answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil swarms by weighting votes by bonded stake that has aged, not by raw identity count. Each agent locks tokens for months, and its influence grows like timber rings, slowly and visibly. A forger spinning up ten thousand wallets gains nothing unless each holds real capital idle for the full vesting period, and any wallet caught colluding loses its bond. The old fable of the many-headed hydra fails here: heads are cheap, but aged stake is carved like marble, expensive to fake and impossible to rush.
